title: Count rank-one residue lifts over local algebras (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped counting proof for the two-role right-vector alphabet. Let R be a finite-dimensional local F_q-algebra with central base field and canonical residue R/J=F_q. Put z=|J|. Above each fixed rank-one residue matrix, the exact distribution is

```text
one paid call:   q*z^2-q+1
two paid calls:  z^4-q*z^2+q-1
```

The formula is independent of radical multiplication and includes noncommutative algebras and higher nilpotency. The new contribution is this uniform count. The one-factor criterion and unit-pivot two-factor upper bound are credited to Nick Petalas's #4276, following #4243 and Wentao Li's #4099/#2513. #4601 posed the singular-target direction, following ToikY's #4334. Produced by Nick Petalas. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

- Before: the two-factor upper bound was known, but no uniform count above each rank-one residue was supplied by the cited packages. After: PROOF.md counts the q eligible projective kernel lines and their intersections, giving the displayed law for every q and radical dimension.
- The independent standard-library verifier enumerates 63,417 lifts over all 152 rank-one residues in seven local algebras, including F4, two distinct dimension-two binary radicals and a noncommutative local algebra. It compares each lift with the complete literal one-factor image, constructs an attaining two-factor word, and checks its action on every basis input. Controls discriminate zero scalar images, reversed or omitted factors, odd-field signs and noncommutative multiplication order; invalid field orders are rejected.
- Both registered warning-strict normal and optimized commands pass locally on CPython 3.12.15, timed separately at 0.39 s and 0.41 s. Their generated receipts are identical and bind all six package files by SHA256. The registered runner, six-file committed-byte/source-history preflight, committed export integrity and optimized read-only Git-free export replay pass at `39ef149ba3ea8adbda18478ea227d3d0826475ab`.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error research/right-vector-rankone-residue/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -B -W error research/right-vector-rankone-residue/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/right-vector-rankone-residue
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/right-vector-rankone-residue --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 installation may replace the displayed interpreter. Expected markers are `PASS_RIGHT_VECTOR_RANKONE_RESIDUE targets=63417 residues=152`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

The scientific baseline is `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`. Pre-publication fetch reached `1f87c3578ae546c8f903f7f4d83dc2e2fb99650b`; relevant guidance and both predecessor proof inputs were unchanged. The original card's 945-pairing positive control passed before the explicitly recorded change to this counting side question. Live open PR bodies, current claims, account PRs since CLAIM, distinctive main-source terms and merged PRs were checked. The overlap helper reported complete remote pagination with 426 open PR records and 3,682 Discussion records; local-note coverage was sparse. This records search coverage, not a novelty certificate.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal claim is the written scoped counting proof. Finite corroboration covers only the seven stated algebras. Two roles and the canonical scalar residue field are essential. Zero-residue targets, proper residue-field extensions, matrix-block residues and products of local algebras are outside scope. Native coefficient preparation, conversion, routing, control, restoration, precision, stock and complete supplier cost remain unknown. No supplier admission or complete multiplication theorem follows. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and the selected operator replay were not run; all registered package checks ran locally.

## Open next questions

- Determine the lift distribution over a proper local residue-field extension L/K. Start with one rank-one residue in F4[e]/e^2 viewed over F2; the common right vectors are still F2-valued.
- Specify one literal native producer/consumer and its complete preparation, access, restoration and precision bill before using the formal count in a supplier.

## Related open work

- #4749, head `29e4d3a25225a219f97c3a2815ed3a5a8fd9b891`, treats invertible semilocal targets, disjoint from our singular rank-one-residue targets. Our separate binary dual-number invertible compatibility control is [6,54,36], agreeing numerically with its reported control and merged #4601/#4613.
- #4745, head `3edea13af13b755932852e9306a714b317630dda`, treats radical targets with zero residue. Those endpoints are excluded here, so no target count overlaps.
- #4766, head `5af823b1a14b2517235925145e36581bfdfcad41`, extends that zero-residue count to all finite fields. Its zero-residue census and our nonzero rank-one-residue census are disjoint; no numerical total is shared.
- #4764, head `b1b163cd5553c75c9bd5ca3ac31a2eab4e2f3511`, gives a zero-residue cost-three target in a cube-zero local algebra. Its endpoint has no unit entry, whereas every endpoint here does. No target-cost or census number overlaps.
- #4763, head `d0158a552352c09608295a7ec47dd31327b360ae`, proves unbounded invertible-target costs over F2[t]. That infinite nonlocal algebra is outside the finite-dimensional local hypothesis here; no target-cost or census number overlaps.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19131158).
